turns.input: Brother Aven gives Nicco a pair of leather boots.
turns.narration:
Brother Aven lifts the worn leather boots from where they'd been tucked under his arm and extends them toward Nicco. "Here. Found these in the chapel's donation pile. Too large for most who come through, and you look to be a man who needs proper footwear." His tired eyes show nothing beyond the practical gesture of charity he performs daily. The boots are scuffed but intact, the leather softened by previous wear.

Nicco takes the offered boots, feeling their weight in his hands. The leather is supple, well-broken-in rather than new.

A quiet moment passes in the moderate foot traffic of Heartstone Square. Brother Aven's gaze drifts toward the tower's massive wooden entrance, then back to Nicco with the patient, evaluating calm of a man who has learned not to ask questions that serve no purpose.

Thanks *he said to them, after which he decides to give them back the boots*
You'll need them more than me
turns.narration:
Nicco thanks Brother Aven and offers the boots back to him.

Brother Aven looks down at the proffered boots, then up at Nicco with a tired, patient expression. "I found them for you," he says quietly. "Keep them. The donation pile's always got something, and my own shoes serve me well enough." He makes no move to take the boots back, standing with his hands loose at his sides.
